features: 4.69 cm (1.85 inch) HD Display: Experience vibrant visuals and crisp clarity on the large 4.69 cm (1.85 inch) HD display, providing a seamless interface for navigating apps, notifications, and fitness stats.
Bluetooth Calling: Stay connected on the go with Bluetooth calling, allowing you to make and receive calls directly from your wrist without needing to reach for your phone.
IP67 Water Resistant: Designed for durability, the IP67 rating ensures protection against dust and water, making it perfect for daily wear, workouts, and outdoor adventures.
Long Battery Life: Enjoy long-lasting performance with extended battery life, allowing you to go about your day without worrying about constant recharging.
25+ Sport Modes: Track a variety of physical activities with over 25 sports modes, providing accurate data to help you meet your fitness goals.
SpO2 & Health Monitoring: Stay on top of your health with advanced SpO2 monitoring, along with heart rate tracking and other health features for complete wellness insights.
200+ Watch Faces: Customize your look with over 200 watch faces, giving you endless options to match your style and mood.
